liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Foolish Heart** (1 review): Jerry performs a second solo around the double stop, creating goosebumps for the listener [19]
- **West L.A. Fadeaway** (1 review): Jerry is described as being on fire during this first set song [20]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Jerry adds backup vocals referencing lovely mermaids, adding ambience and engagement to the track [20]
- **Morning Dew** (1 review): Brent’s organ playing is called magical, especially the punctuation added during the lyrics [22]
- **Terrapin** (1 review): The band plays around with the instrumental ending for about six and a half minutes [23]

## The recordings

- **gd89-07-19.sbd.437.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 167 min; rated 4.68/5 by 105 [1]. Said about its sound: The sound quality is described as near perfect, matching the level of the performance; The recording quality is praised as awesome, making the listener feel like they were there again [23][27]
- **gd1989-07-19.mtx.hansokolow.96232.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 173 min; rated 4.38/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1989-07-19.senn441.coniff.gmb.92447.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 162 min; rated 4.4/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Audio problems occur at the beginning of Hell In A Bucket from the PA [3]
- **gd1989-07-19.138818.UltraMatrix.sbd.miller.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 178 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [7]

## Around the show

- The listener attended the first and third shows, recalling mud and amazing music throughout [21]
- Rain made the grass a mess, prompting the listener to choose reserved seating [22]
- It rained during all three shows, which the listener remembers vividly alongside the music [25]
- The listener, soaked in the rain, saw a rainbow over the valley during the second set [27]
- This was the last Grateful Dead show at Alpine Valley before a local ban [30]
- Mexican Hat Dance tuning occurs before Victim Or The Crime [7]
- The listener considers this the best of the three shows held at Alpine Valley [24]
- The three-show run is arguably the finest example of the latter-day Dead [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd89-07-19.sbd.437.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> DAT> CD> eac> SHN [1]
- **gd1989-07-19.mtx.hansokolow.96232.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [2]. Also: Recorded by Casey Coniff using Sennheiser 441 and Marantz PDM 340 with dbx [2]
- **gd1989-07-19.senn441.coniff.gmb.92447.flac16**: taped by Casey Coniff; transferred by Bill Koucky; source: Sennheiser 441 > Marantz PDM 340 w/ dbx (Cassette Master Maxell MX-S 90) [3]
- **gd1989-07-19.138818.UltraMatrix.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [7]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to make this show complete [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1989-07-19 Alpine Valley Music Theatre, East Troy, WI, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1989-07-19-alpine-valley-music-theatre-east-troy-wi-usa/) [32]
